title: WeChat Work AI Assistant Closed Beta: Write a Weekly Report in One Sentence, Tackle 99+ Group Chat Messages

content_html:
Tencent has announced that the enterprise WeChat AI smart assistant "Da Yuan" has officially entered internal testing. Mobile users can swipe left on the side handle in any interface of Enterprise WeChat to directly activate it, while desktop users can access it through the "Smart Assistant" entry in the left sidebar. The entire process does not require switching applications or interrupting the current workflow.

From climbing stairs to writing weekly reports, it takes over daily office work in one go

Da Yuan's most direct capability is "climbing stairs" — facing group chat messages with 99+ unread messages, numerous unread voice messages, and information, it can automatically extract key points of the conversation, summarize voice content, and generate to-do items based on the dialogue. In deeper office scenarios, Da Yuan can access dozens of native Enterprise WeChat capabilities such as smart documents, smart spreadsheets, meetings, and schedules, and supports sending messages and emails at scheduled times.

For example, when writing a weekly report, users just need to input "help me write this week's report," and Da Yuan can automatically retrieve messages, documents, and emails in Enterprise WeChat, sort out completed tasks, project progress, and recap content, and generate a well-structured initial draft of the weekly report that can be directly modified. Compared to copying and pasting information into third-party tools in the past, completing the entire process directly within the app significantly reduces the friction and repetitive operations caused by switching between applications.

The appearance of Da Yuan marks that Enterprise WeChat is accelerating its transformation from a communication and collaboration tool into an AI-driven intelligent office hub. When 99+ messages no longer cause anxiety and weekly reports are no longer a nightmare on Sunday nights — can AI assistants truly fulfill the promise of "working less and producing more"? The feedback from internal testers will provide the first answer.

content_html_zh:
腾讯宣布，企业微信AI智能助手“大缘”正式进入内测。 移动用户可以在企业微信任意界面向左滑动侧手柄直接激活，桌面用户则可以通过左侧边栏的“智能助手”入口访问。 整个过程不需要切换应用程序或中断当前工作流程。

从爬楼梯到写周报，一劳永逸接管日常办公工作

大元最直接的能力就是“爬楼梯”——面对99+条未读消息、海量未读语音信息和信息的群聊消息，它可以自动提取对话要点，总结语音内容，并根据对话生成待办事项。 在更深层次的办公场景中，大元可以接入智能文档、智能电子表格、会议、日程等数十种企业微信原生能力，并支持定时发送消息和邮件。

例如，写周报时，用户只需输入“帮我写本周报告”，大元就能自动检索企业微信中的消息、文档、邮件，整理已完成的任务、项目进度、内容回顾，生成结构清晰、可直接修改的周报初稿。 与过去将信息复制粘贴到第三方工具中相比，直接在应用程序内完成整个过程大大减少了应用程序之间切换带来的摩擦和重复操作。

大元的出现，标志着企业微信正在加速从沟通协作工具向AI驱动的智能办公枢纽转型。 当99条以上的消息不再引起焦虑，周报不再是周日晚上的噩梦时——人工智能助手能否真正兑现“更少工作、更多产出”的承诺？ 内部测试人员的反馈将提供第一个答案。
